records.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit target: original 8-row, two-column PS2 capsule-button texture. Replace ONLY the sixteen English words, accurately preserving the exact blue/orange industrial metal capsule frames, angular blue highlights, mechanical texture, original row spacing and transparent outside. In BOTH columns, rows top to bottom must read exactly: 简单 / 普通 / 困难 / 詹妮弗 / 布鲁斯 / 艾伦 / 亨利 / 弗兰克. Match the original condensed bold font, slight metallic bevel, small dark outline and face color: silver-white on blue, warm pale gold on orange. All rows and both states MUST use visually identical Chinese glyph height (about the original letter height), and matching word width for the same word. Remove ALL original letter strokes, dark shadows and halos, including behind and above/below the new characters; restore the natural textured button material seamlessly underneath, not a flat blue/orange rectangle. Crisp legible lettering, no speckled JPEG noise, no extraneous lines or glowing plaques. Do not redesign, enlarge, simplify, move or replace the original frames or corner highlights. Keep 8 rows, not 7 or 9. Output the edited atlas only, no comparison or captions. True transparency outside the capsules.

Use case: text-localization. Edit target: this exact PS2 game texture atlas, enlarged 4x. Preserve all positions, shapes, palette, metal/glass gradients, frame edges and upper blank bars. Replace the five English names in BOTH blue and orange columns, top to bottom, with these exact Chinese names: 约翰, 迈克尔, 卢克, 凯莉, 简. Same heavy condensed beveled metallic original font style: blue state silver-white with dark steel edge, orange state yellow-gold with dark bronze edge. SAME glyph core height in both states (about 52 image pixels), same text width and centered position. Remove ALL old English strokes, dark outlines, halos behind Chinese; reconstruct continuous original blue/orange translucent metal texture underneath, not a solid rectangle. Keep the visible patterned button interiors and all original borders. No other text. Output 1024x1024 atlas, transparency outside buttons as in source.

Use case: text-localization. Edit target: supplied original two-frame PS2 LOADING eye texture. Replace only LOADING... in BOTH eye images with exactly 正在加载… (one ellipsis character). The TOP is the clear/open frame and BOTTOM is the intentionally horizontally motion-blurred transition frame. Both MUST depict the SAME base Chinese lettering at exactly the same visual height and character width, same center, same thin upright sans-serif style as original, pale pink-white light with subtle red glow; the lower frame may have horizontal smear but not be enlarged or reduced. Fully remove the English letter silhouettes, dark shadows and red text glow by restoring the organic eye/iris ridges naturally and seamlessly; do not paint any black rectangle or flat black strip. Preserve original eye outline, lid folds, all non-text pixels, muted organic texture and red peripheral glow. No box, plaque, new border, opaque backing, heavy Chinese serif, bevel or metallic effect. Keep both frames in their original atlas halves and preserve black/transparent surroundings. Output atlas only with both frames, no captions or comparison.

records.prompt:
Use case: text-localization
Asset type: transparent paired footer lettering for a Korean PS2 horror game localization.
Input images: Image 1 is the original U204 game texture, reference only; Image 2 is the original U317 atlas, reference only. Their footer OK and BACK lettering defines the original fine white serif/printed optical style. Do not redraw their backgrounds or controller icons.
Primary request: Draw only two separate exact Simplified Chinese labels, 确定 and 返回. Both labels consist of exactly two Hanzi. Place 确定 on the left and 返回 on the right with generous transparent separation. Give all four Hanzi exactly the same square em cell, visible core height, thickness, baseline and spacing. Do NOT make 确定 smaller to mimic the shorter Latin word OK, and do NOT make 返回 bigger to fill the longer BACK region. They must be equal-size peers.
Style: precise finely cut off-white Song/Ming serif lettering that faithfully matches the original narrow high-contrast white serif labels. Clear open counters, subtle triangular serifs and slight stroke contrast. Native PS2 UI print style, not modern sans, not calligraphy, not brush, not 3D. Crisp clean strokes with no grit, artificial scratches, JPEG noise, glow, dark border, shadow or underlining. This is artwork to be reduced to a 13-pixel-high native UI, so interior strokes must remain distinct.
Text verbatim: 确定   返回
Composition: one straight horizontal row, exactly those four characters, two equal-width words with large blank gap; ample blank transparent margins; no other objects.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no black backing panels, no rectangles, no caption, no English, no icon, no frame. Neither reference texture is to be reproduced. Output only the four white Chinese glyphs.
records.registration: Source-bound original CLUT; equal per-character cells and baseline; all O/X and unrelated text retained; U204/U208 original13/13,current9/14,corrected13/13.
